title: pith.saboteur-packet/v1
$comment: A candidate adequacy gap brought to gate/redteam.py from outside (an agent or a person): a mutant the pack's gate should refuse, the intent it violates, and a witness that shows it. docs/rfc/0007-autonomous-assurance-and-runtime-composition.md § 4. FROZEN with the evaluator.

base.description: examples: the reference example the files are overlaid on (default: the pack's redteam.examples.base)

generated.description: examples: the id of a mutant `gate/redteam.py run --generate` reported, instead of files

design.description: spec: a design module the release's checked properties should reject

test.description: examples: a pytest module run from the judged workspace's root; it must fail on the mutant and pass on the reference

property.description: spec: a property the reference satisfies and the design violates
